purpose: Phase 8-9 supplementary source observations gathered on 7 October 2026 to extend isolated and follower tests. The Phase 4 atlas is not modified; these entries are merged at test-spec time. Full texts were not reachable (session egress policy blocks journal hosts): every value is transcribed from search-result abstracts/snippets and is labelled as such. Values are context for test amplitudes and follower magnitudes, never character range-of-motion limits.
retrieval: WebSearch snippets of abstracts/tables; second-source agreement noted where available.

C0C1_BIPLANE_2024.citation: Dynamic in vivo 3D atlantooccipital kinematics during multiplanar physiologic motions, J Biomech 2024 (ScienceDirect S0021929024003142)

ANDERST_2013_JBJS.citation: Anderst WJ et al. 2013, J Bone Joint Surg: cervical motion after single-level anterior arthrodesis vs asymptomatic controls, Table II

YU_2017_JBE.citation: Yu Y et al. 2017, J Biomech Eng: Ranges of cervical intervertebral disc deformation during an in vivo dynamic flexion-extension of the neck

MCP_ABDUCTION_CLINICAL.citation: Goniometry: finger metacarpophalangeal abduction (Physiopedia); MCP joint anatomy (Kenhub)

BEYER_2014_CVJ.citation: Beyer B et al. 2014, Clin Biomech: In vivo thorax 3D modelling from costovertebral joint complex kinematics

THUMB_OPPOSITION_3DCT.citation: Motion analysis of the trapeziometacarpal joint using three-dimensional computed tomography, J Hand Surg Asian Pac Vol 2016 (World Scientific S2424835516500120)

KAWANISHI_2017.citation: Kawanishi Y et al. 2017, J Hand Surg: In vivo 3-dimensional kinematics of thumb carpometacarpal joint during thumb opposition

PATELLA_LUNGE.citation: Physiological sagittal plane patellar kinematics during dynamic deep knee flexion (PMC3728417)

FIBULA_RSA_1989.citation: In vivo fibular motions during various movements of the ankle, Clin Biomech 1989

c0c1_fe_total.motion: C0-C1 flexion-extension range during physiologic motion
c0c1_fe_total.measured_scope: occiput relative to C1 (biplane radiography, 30 fps)
c0c1_fe_total.conflicts: Other reports: in vivo 6.3 deg (cited by the same paper), cadaver 24-27 deg, a 2026 facet study 25.6 +/- 5.9 deg. Flexion/extension split not accessible.
c0c1_fe_total.note: Motion almost exclusively in-plane; lateral bending and axial rotation not used.

cervical_ctrl_c6_c7_extension.second_source: YU_2017_JBE: totals 14-17 deg at C3/4-C5/6 and 9.4 +/- 4.2 deg at C6/7 (10 asymptomatic volunteers), consistent with the Anderst totals 14.2/15.9/14.7/12.5 within one SD.

mcp_abduction_clinical.note: Kenhub gives a 25-30 deg abduction-adduction arc, mostly abduction; abduction is lost with the MCP flexed. Per-digit normative values not accessible.

rib_cvj_range.motion: Rib rotation at the costovertebral joint between functional residual and total lung capacity
rib_cvj_range.measured_scope: ribs 1-10 relative to their vertebra (CT at FRC, MIC, TLC)
rib_cvj_range.note: Range decreases with rib number (smallest at rib 7 in the reported set); motion mainly about mediolateral and anteroposterior axes; lung volume and rib angle are not proportional. Axis labels of the decomposition are not transcribed.

thumb_opposition_tmc.motion: Trapeziometacarpal palmar abduction at maximal opposition
thumb_opposition_tmc.note: Pronation reported as 42 +/- 9 deg in radial abduction and 99 +/- 3 deg in opposition in Cheema's frame; the zero of that frame is not transferable to the fitted rest pose, so the pronation magnitude stays unresolved. Kawanishi: the first metacarpal abducts, rotates internally and flexes from radial abduction to opposition.

patellar_flexion_ratio.motion: Patellar flexion relative to the femur per degree of knee flexion
patellar_flexion_ratio.measured_scope: patella vs femur, single-leg lunge 0-165 deg (lateral radiographs)
patellar_flexion_ratio.second_source: Same ratio (0.66) reported by a cadaver study up to 100 deg of flexion (cited in the same paper).
patellar_flexion_ratio.note: Task: lunge; the patellar translation path is not sourced.

fibula_ankle_rsa.motion: Distal fibula relative to the tibia from 30 deg plantarflexion to 30 deg dorsiflexion
fibula_ankle_rsa.conflicts: A physical-therapy text describes proximal fibular migration in dorsiflexion; gait studies report up to 4 mm superior-inferior translation during stance (different task). Fibular rotation: small, unquantified in the accessible abstract (not applied).

unresolved.l1_l2: No accessible in vivo L1/L2 value (lifting studies image L2-S1). No test added.
unresolved.c2_c3_and_c7_t1: Control values not in the accessible table rows. No test added.
unresolved.sc_elevation: Clavicular elevation during humeral elevation: a review gives below 10 deg; a bone-pin study in a systematic review 13 deg; bony-sensor studies 6.5-11 deg; another study 25-28 deg (method-dependent). Conflict: not applied.
unresolved.midfoot_tmt_lesser_toes: Not searched successfully in this round; no follower added.
unresolved.rib_8_to_12: Lower-rib values not in the accessible abstract. Only ribs 1-7 are tested.
unresolved.patellar_translation_path: Not sourced; patella is rotated about the fitted knee axis (circular trochlea assumption) and the path is reported as unvalidated.
